name: ForgeOS — Identity & Skill Progression System
problem: Traditional habit trackers focus on checklists, making it hard to connect daily routines to the person you want to become.
solution: ForgeOS ties routines to personal identities and turns deliberate actions into votes for who you are becoming, with XP progression, continuity tracking, and Android and web apps.
outcome: Web app and Android app available.

name: Foliant
problem: A 400-page PDF is hard to study from on a phone: no chapters, no highlights, and no easy way to revise what you read.
solution: Foliant turns any PDF into an interactive reading book with chapter bookmarks, colour highlights, a focus reading mode and flashcard generation. It works offline, as a Progressive Web App and an Android app.

name: Smart Knowledge Dashboard
problem: When something breaks in production, engineers lose time hunting across error logs, runbooks and past fixes kept in different places.
solution: A GenAI-assisted dashboard that links error logs, runbooks and resolution suggestions through semantic retrieval, designed to cut incident triage time. It began as a vibe-coding prototype and was selected for enterprise development.

name: Enterprise healthcare retail modules
problem: A Fortune 50 healthcare retail client needed pharmacy workflow modules that stay available and correct under heavy daily use.
solution: I built resilient REST APIs, automated SQL Server backend services and dynamic React views, and led Prod and UAT migrations for 2,000+ users.
outcome: Zero post-delivery defects and 100% SLA compliance.

name: Full-stack .NET, React and Azure Anki deck
problem: Interview preparation for full-stack .NET roles is scattered across documentation, videos and blog posts, and hard to revise on the move.
solution: A curated deck of 390+ mobile-friendly spaced-repetition flashcards covering C#, ASP.NET Core, EF Core, React architecture, Azure infrastructure and SQL performance tuning.

name: System Design Interview Mastery
problem: System design interview prep is usually overwhelming, filled with generic textbook diagrams and lacking realistic verbal answers, scale calculations, and practical .NET/cloud context.
solution: A structured 6-day curriculum with 60 high-yield questions, verbal delivery scripts, ASCII architecture blueprints, and an interactive 3D flashcard study engine.
outcome: 60 questions, 6 days, interactive web portal & roadmap.
